newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo rubber prices rise on drought fears.
newsitem.headline: Colombo rubber prices rise on drought fears.

text.p: Rubber prices remained bouyant at Thursday's auction on strong demand prompted by fears of a production shortfall due to drought and on higher overseas prices, brokers said.
"The overseas market has gone up. Also we expect production to fall because of drought," said a broker at Forbes and Walker. "This should keep the market fairly high in the coming weeks."

Best latex crepe one-x rose 50 cents to 74.50 rupees per kg, number one rose 50 to 73.50 while RSS1 was unquoted after trading at 62 rupees on Tuesday. Brokers said 222 tonnes of crepe, 74 tonnes of scrap crepe and 62 tonnes of sheet were offered. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
